5 تبعّلت : see 1. ―
-b2- Also She was obedient to her husband; (K;) [so too ↓ ابتعلت , as will be seen from what follows;] and so تبعّلت زَوْجَهَا: (TA:) or she adorned herself for her husband. (K.) You say ↓ اِمْرَأَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ الاِبْتِعَالِ A woman who is good in obedience to her husband. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
